description: This file contains unit tests for the WebAudioPlayer component, specifically testing miscellaneous functions such as play, pause, setEos, setVolume, and getVolume. It uses Google Test framework and mocks to verify interactions with the underlying WebAudioGstPlayer.

classes.name: RialtoServerWebAudioPlayerMiscellaneousFunctionsTest
classes.description: A test fixture class inheriting from WebAudioPlayerTestBase, used to test miscellaneous functions of the WebAudioPlayer, including play, pause, setEos, setVolume, and getVolume.

methods.name: notifyApiCalled
methods.description: Sets a flag and notifies condition variable to indicate that an API call has been made.

methods.name: waitForApiCalled
methods.description: Waits for the notifyApiCalled to be triggered, indicating the API call has completed.
